seed_ledger.name: Fortis Inc: gas supply to its plants in development
seed_ledger.reason: Springerville power station (1308 MW, TEP coal conversion): NO_DC_TIE. Gas arrives by a new lateral, Energy Transfer's Springerville Lateral on Transwestern (about 120 miles, 30 inch, about 625 MMcf/d, service Q4 2029, announced May 2026), but TEP's repowering filings and page cite reliability and the 2023 resource plan, not data center load, and the Arizona regulator coverage only mentions data center demand in general. Lateral is a power-plant line with no plant-level data center tie, so no candidate (over 25 km, so belongs to the 2026-10-02 pass; not in the roster under its own name, nearest rows are P0273 Transwestern main line and P7840 Desert Southwest Expansion). Searches run: 3. Sources checked: TEP Springerville repowering page (conversion by 2030, no data center mention); Energy Transfer open season notice (lateral serves eastern Arizona generation); KJZZ March 2026 (commission approval, general demand framing).

evidence.note: TEP repowering page, no data center tie
Transwestern open season for Springerville Lateral

seed_ledger.name: APAG Energy AG: gas supply to its plants in development
seed_ledger.reason: Maple Creek Energy Project (Sullivan County, Indiana): NO_DC_TIE and no named gas supply project. Site has gas and electric interconnections near SR-63, no lateral or pipeline sponsor named; first phase 640 MW with a GE Vernova turbine, 2029 target. A 2025 request for proposals sought offtake or co-location partners but named no data center or hyperscaler. Searches run: 2. Sources checked: Power Magazine turbine story (plant specs, owners, no pipeline, no data center); web results on the 2025 partner request (co-location open, no named tie); nothing found on a FERC or Indiana regulator docket for a lateral.

evidence.note: plant specs and ownership, no pipeline or data center tie
